about: IELTS micro-skill map. Every piece of feedback, every drill, every review item, and every logged lost mark is tagged with one of these skill ids, so the same weakness is counted once across papers. 'papers' = where the skill costs marks; 'criteria' = the descriptor it feeds; 'codes' = error codes modules use when tagging (a tag may be a skill id or a code); 'drills' = ids in references/drills.md.

skills.name: Recognising and producing paraphrase
skills.detect: Missed answer because question wording differed from the text/recording; or repeats prompt words in writing/speaking.

skills.name: Natural collocation and word choice
skills.detect: Grammatical but unnatural combinations (do a mistake, kill the spare time).

skills.name: Word form / derivation
skills.detect: Right root, wrong part of speech; completion answers that don't fit the gap's grammar.

skills.name: Spelling of answer and essay words
skills.detect: Heard/found the right word but misspelt it; LR spelling errors.

skills.name: Plural and countability
skills.detect: Missing -s after numbers/quantifiers; completion answers marked wrong for singular/plural.

skills.name: Extending a point with reason, example, consequence
skills.detect: Ideas listed but not explained; one-line GT bullets; Part 1/3 answers that stop after one sentence.

skills.name: Linking, referencing, paragraph logic
skills.detect: Mechanical or wrong linkers, double connectors (although...but), unclear it/this/they, no clear paragraph focus.

skills.name: Tone and formality for the reader/situation
skills.detect: Informal language in formal letters/essays, tone drift, wrong greeting/closing pair.

skills.name: Less common and idiomatic vocabulary used precisely
skills.detect: Only common words; or 'fancy' words used imprecisely (caps LR at 6).

skills.name: Keeping your place in the recording
skills.detect: Never heard the answer sentence; lost track after a missed question; lost the speaker in Section 3.

skills.name: Rejecting corrected/rejected/other-speaker information
skills.detect: Wrote information that was later corrected, rejected, or belonged to another speaker/time.

skills.name: Numbers, dates, prices, spelled names
skills.detect: 13 vs 30, 15 vs 50, wrong date/time format, misspelt spelled-out names.

skills.name: Map / plan directions
skills.detect: Wrong label on map/plan questions; lost the starting point or orientation.

skills.name: Decoding connected speech (linking, weak forms, elision)
skills.detect: Understands the transcript but could not hear it in the audio.

skills.name: Opinion, agreement, and decision in discussions
skills.detect: Section 3 MC/matching errors: suggestion vs final decision, who agreed with whom.

skills.name: Answer format and word limits
skills.detect: Over the word limit, incomplete numbers, hyphen errors.

skills.name: True/False/Not Given and Yes/No/Not Given decisions
skills.detect: Confusing False with Not Given; using outside knowledge; missing qualifiers (some/all/always).

skills.name: Main idea of a paragraph (matching headings)
skills.detect: Picking a heading that matches a detail or a repeated word rather than the whole paragraph.

skills.name: Scanning for specific information
skills.detect: Running out of time on matching information/features; can't find names, numbers, dates fast.

skills.name: Summary/sentence/table completion from the text
skills.detect: Right area of text, wrong word; answer doesn't fit the gap grammatically; paraphrased summary not mapped.

skills.name: Multiple choice elimination
skills.detect: Choosing the option with matching words rather than matching meaning.

skills.name: Time management across 3 passages
skills.detect: Unfinished questions; Passage 3 rushed; too long on one question.

skills.name: Clear overview of main trends/stages/differences
skills.detect: No overview, overview buried in details, or overview that lists data.

skills.name: Selecting and comparing key features
skills.detect: Lists every figure; misses a category; describes without comparing.

skills.name: Accurate trend, comparison, process, and map language
skills.detect: Wrong figures, wrong prepositions with numbers (rose by/to), repetitive increase/decrease.

skills.name: GT letter: purpose and full bullet coverage
skills.detect: Unclear purpose, missing or one-line bullets, no clear request/next step.

skills.name: Answering every part of the question
skills.detect: Only part of a two-part/discuss-both-views question answered; off-topic drift.

skills.name: Clear, consistent position and thesis
skills.detect: Position unclear, changes between intro and conclusion, or thesis restates the prompt only.

skills.name: One controlling idea per body paragraph
skills.detect: Paragraphs with two unrelated ideas, or ideas split across paragraphs.

skills.name: Extending answers naturally (Parts 1 and 3)
skills.detect: One-sentence answers; answers padded with filler rather than reasons/examples.

skills.name: Part 2 long turn: cover the card, sustain 2 minutes
skills.detect: Stops before 2 minutes, skips bullets, or recites a memorised script.

skills.name: Part 3 abstract reasoning: compare, speculate, generalise
skills.detect: Personal anecdotes instead of general views; can't discuss past/future trends.

skills.name: Hesitation, fillers, self-correction
skills.detect: Long pauses searching for language, repetition, 'how to say'.

skills.name: Final consonants and -s/-ed endings
skills.detect: Dropped word endings (common for Indonesian speakers): 'work' for 'worked', 'book' for 'books'.

skills.name: Individual sounds (th, v/f, sh/s, vowel length)
skills.detect: th → t/d, v → f, ship/sheep confusions.

skills.name: Word stress, sentence stress, intonation, chunking
skills.detect: Flat or syllable-timed rhythm; wrong stress (de-VE-lop, PHO-to-graph vs pho-TO-gra-phy).

skills.name: Articles and determiners
skills.detect: Missing a/the before singular countable nouns; 'the' for general classes.

skills.name: Subject–verb agreement
skills.detect: He go / the results shows.

skills.name: Tense and aspect
skills.detect: Past events in present; since/for without present perfect; wrong tense in Task 1 time periods.

skills.name: Verb patterns, modals, copula
skills.detect: enjoy to read, can goes, missing 'be' (She very busy), will in if-clauses.

skills.name: Prepositions and dependent prepositions
skills.detect: depend of, discuss about, in/on/at confusion, rose by/to.

skills.name: Word order
skills.detect: a car red; I know where is he.

skills.name: Pronouns and reference (he/she, it/there)
skills.detect: he/she swaps, missing dummy it/there, redundant pronouns.

skills.name: Sentence boundaries (run-ons, fragments, comma splices)
skills.detect: Two clauses joined by a comma; fragments starting with Because/Which.

skills.name: Range of complex structures used accurately
skills.detect: Only simple sentences (caps GRA at 5–6); or complex attempts that break down.
